title: 第一卷 第11章 在他怀中颤抖-《我养的AI竟是京圈太子爷》
content:
第(1/3)页

    “我……我不会，没看到你的”，上官程难得慌到语无伦次，“我意思是，我没有乱看，我对女人的身体没有兴趣。”

    为了证明自己，他眼睛闭得像两扇焊死的铁门。

    前世的记忆像潮水般涌来——继母曾把一个全身赤裸的女人强行塞进他的房间，那浓烈的香水味、刺眼的肉色、以及那种被强行撩拨的恶心感，令他排斥到了极点，当场吐了出来。

    那痛苦的感觉他不愿经历第二次。

    也怕自己的反应会让霖多多难堪。

    然而霖多多见他这样不听劝，竟是干脆下了一道命令：“329，睁眼！”

    命令下达的瞬间，上官程根本来不及反抗，眼皮便倏然分开，像被人强行撬开的蚌壳。

    “不要！”

    “什么不要？你瞪大眼睛仔细看看我穿没穿？！”

    惊乱无比间，女孩嘲弄的笑容闯入视野，带着山水墨韵的色彩。

    原来她并非一丝不挂，方才的言语只是在逗弄他。是他太过紧张，才忽略了对方语气之中的戏谑。

    霖多多穿着一套黑色的连体泳衣，简约的剪裁，没有多余的装饰，包裹着纤细的身体，露出两截白生生的胳膊和腿。黑色的布料衬得她的皮肤越发白皙，像一块温润的白玉。

    “哈哈哈哈！惊不惊喜意不意外！？”霖多多一副恶作剧得逞的模样，“你当我什么人啊，光天化日之下裸泳？我霖多多性格是有些奔放，但不是肆无忌惮！”

    “早想好要来这里抓鱼的，所以提前把泳衣穿在里面了。”

    霖多多笑得得意洋洋，一手叉腰，一手执叉，下巴微扬，像一只打了胜仗的小猫。

    “现在还是非礼勿视吗？”

    上官程却再次闭上了眼睛。

    “太少。”

    霖多多：“……喂喂。”

    她盯着他那副闭着眼睛、一脸正气的模样，无奈叹气。

    “你说你，一个最先进的科技产物，怎么就觉醒了这么保守的意识？AI和尚？封建老古董？”

    “我……”

    “你到底帮不帮我抓鱼？闭着眼可抓不到啊！”

    “我的意思是……”上官程深吸一口气，耐着性子解释，“不如交给我来抓，你上岸休息。机器人不怕冷，不用呼吸，更不会溺水，你想吃多少，我就给你抓多少。”

    “不行！”

    霖多多的语气坚决得像在发某种誓言，声音在瀑布的轰鸣中格外清晰。

    “我一定要自己抓到！”

"I...I won't, I didn't see you." Shangguan Cheng was so flustered that he was incoherent, "I mean, I didn't look around, I'm not interested in women's bodies."

To prove himself, he closed his eyes like two welded iron doors.

Memories of his past life came flooding back - his stepmother once forced a naked woman into his room. The strong smell of perfume, the dazzling flesh color, and the disgusting feeling of being forcibly aroused made him so repelled that he vomited it out on the spot.

He didn’t want to experience that painful feeling a second time.

I am also afraid that my reaction will embarrass Lin Duoduo.

However, when Lin Duoduo saw that he was not listening to advice, he simply gave an order: "329, open your eyes!"

The moment the order was given, Shangguan Cheng had no time to resist, and his eyelids suddenly parted, like a clam shell being forcibly opened.

"No!"

"Why don't you want it? Open your eyes and look carefully to see if I'm wearing anything?!"

In the midst of great panic, the girl's mocking smile burst into view, with the color of landscape and ink.

It turned out that she was not naked, and her words just now were just teasing him.It was because he was too nervous that he ignored the joking in the other party's tone.

Lin Duoduo was wearing a black one-piece swimsuit, with a simple cut and no unnecessary decoration. It covered her slender body and exposed two white arms and legs.The black fabric made her skin whiter and whiter, like a piece of warm white jade.

"Hahahaha! Are you surprised or not!?" Lin Duoduo looked like he had succeeded in his prank, "Who do you think I am, swimming naked in broad daylight? I, Lin Duoduo, have a somewhat unrestrained personality, but I am not unscrupulous!"

“I had already planned to come here to catch fish, so I put my swimsuit on in advance.”

Lin Duoduo smiled triumphantly, with one hand on her hips and the other holding a fork, her chin slightly raised, like a kitten winning a battle.

“Are you still looking at no evil now?”

Shangguan Cheng closed his eyes again.

"Too little."

Lin Duoduo: "...Hey, hey."

She stared at his righteous look with his eyes closed, and sighed helplessly.

"How come you, a most advanced technological product, have awakened such a conservative consciousness? AI monk? Feudal antique?"

"I..."

"Will you help me catch fish? You can't catch it with your eyes closed!"

"What I mean is..." Shangguan Cheng took a deep breath and explained patiently, "Why don't you leave it to me to catch it, and you can go ashore to rest. The robot is not afraid of the cold, does not need to breathe, and will not drown. I will catch as much as you want to eat."

"No!"

Lin Duoduo’s tone was as firm as if he was making some kind of oath, and his voice was particularly clear amid the roar of the waterfall.

“I must catch it myself!”
